verses.text: This is the list of the Israelites who served the king: the heads of families, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers. They served the king in all matters, in army groups that came on and went off duty month by month all through the year. Each group had twenty-four thousand men.
Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first group, for the first month. There were twenty-four thousand men in his group.
He was a descendant of Perez and the chief of all the army officers for the first month.
Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the group for the second month. Mikloth was the leader of his group. There were twenty-four thousand men in his group.
The third army commander, for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest. There were twenty-four thousand men in his group.
This was the Benaiah who was a mighty warrior among the Thirty and in charge of the Thirty. His son Ammizabad was in charge of his group.
The fourth, for the fourth month, was Asahel, Joab's brother. His son Zebadiah took his place after him. There were twenty-four thousand men in his group.
The fifth, for the fifth month, was Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were twenty-four thousand men in his group.
The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira son of Ikkesh from Tekoa. There were twenty-four thousand men in his group.
The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, from the tribe of Ephraim. There were twenty-four thousand men in his group.
The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, from the clan of Zerah. There were twenty-four thousand men in his group.
The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer from Anathoth, from the tribe of Benjamin. There were twenty-four thousand men in his group.
The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai from Netophah, from the clan of Zerah. There were twenty-four thousand men in his group.
The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah from Pirathon, from the tribe of Ephraim. There were twenty-four thousand men in his group.
The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai from Netophah, from the family of Othniel. There were twenty-four thousand men in his group.
These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel: over Reuben, Eliezer son of Zichri; over Simeon, Shephatiah son of Maacah;
over Levi, Hashabiah son of Kemuel; over the descendants of Aaron, Zadok;
over Judah, Elihu, one of David's brothers; over Issachar, Omri son of Michael;
over Zebulun, Ishmaiah son of Obadiah; over Naphtali, Jeremoth son of Azriel;
over Ephraim, Hoshea son of Azaziah; over the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel son of Pedaiah;
over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo son of Zechariah; over Benjamin, Jaasiel son of Abner;
over Dan, Azarel son of Jeroham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.
David did not count the men who were twenty years old or younger, because the LORD had promised to make Israel as many as the stars in the sky.
Joab son of Zeruiah began to count them but did not finish, because God's anger came on Israel because of the counting. So the total number was never written in the history book of King David.
Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the king's storehouses. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the countryside, in the towns, in the villages, and in the towers.
Ezri son of Chelub was in charge of the farm workers who worked the land.
Shimei from Ramah was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of storing the wine from the vineyards.
Baal-Hanan from Geder was in charge of the olive and fig trees in the western foothills. Joash was in charge of storing the olive oil.
Shitrai from Sharon was in charge of the cattle grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the cattle in the valleys.
Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah from Meronoth was in charge of the donkeys. Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks.
All these were the officials in charge of King David's property.
Jonathan, David's uncle, was an adviser, a wise man, and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hachmoni looked after the king's sons.
Ahithophel was the king's adviser. Hushai the Archite was the king's friend.
After Ahithophel came Jehoiada son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the king's army.
